camp.name: Delvers' Camp
features: a timbered hall carved into the rock: three aisles of spruce posts and beams, lanterns under every beam
four bunks set into rock niches, a mess table with a half-eaten supper, a smoker and a cookfire hearth
a forge corner: two blast furnaces under a brick chimney, an anvil, a grindstone, a quench tub, a tool rack
ore bins heaped with raw iron, raw copper, coal and a little gold, fed by the rail from the drifts
the foreman's corner: the Ore Ledger on a lectern, the foreman's chest, a survey map on the wall
three miners and their foreman at four prospecting tables; they trade and tell you where other delves are
rail drifts propped with timber every four blocks, branching and turning, lit all the way
working faces where the walls are thick with coal, iron, copper, redstone, lapis and a little gold
chest minecarts of ore on the rails; the ladder-and-scaffold shaft "we use", capped in rock

seam.name: The Buried Seam
features: a Guild gallery wrecked by a cave-in: snapped and missing props, sagging beams, twisted rails with gaps
robbed pillars: the rock left to hold the roof, cut to the waist for the gold in it
the fall itself: a rubble slope up to a broken dome in the roof, crushed beams sticking out of it
the foreman's shack, a candle still in the window: the lectern holds "The Last Shift", the log cut off mid-line
a derailed chest minecart and the remains of the shift at the foot of the fall
behind the fall, the rich seam: a sealed chamber crowded with gold, iron, redstone, lapis, a few diamonds and raw gold blocks, with the seam/rich chest and what is left of Tamsin and Young Pell
restless miners rise in the gallery and in an old working
a side drift choked with cobwebs round a cave-spider spawner
drifts half buried by falls you must dig through or crawl over; dim: a few candles, one last lantern

post.name: Deepwatch Post
features: a barbican across a cave road: the road runs in under a raised iron portcullis and out the far side
two archer towers with arrow slits, ladders and braziers on top; crenellated curtain wall and gatehouse walk
a lit killing ground outside the gate: braziers, stakes, a burn pile of bones and a tally of the season's kills
the keep: barracks with five bunks and footlockers, the captain's room with the Deepwatch Log and his chest
a mess under a lean-to with a cookfire, smoker and half-eaten meal; Deepwatch banners everywhere
armory and drill yard: training dummies and archery targets for the garrison, weapon racks, anvil, grindstone
the Deepgate: an Old Delver arch with the gold lantern mark, shut with the Watch's iron door and a locked lever
behind it the stair down to a sealed chamber with its chest, where the Long Stair goes on down behind bars
the names of the seven lost on the Long Patrol chalked on the barracks wall; the oath and the motto on signs
a hisser tally by the gate and the marked watch-candle in the gate tower's guard room
garrison: two knights, two archers and the Watch Captain
the cave road runs on out of both ends through lamp-lit tunnels, past a roadside watch niche

cistern.name: The Drowned Cistern
features: a vaulted Old Delver reservoir: groin vaults on two rows of pillars, ribs of polished deepslate
the basin: still water five blocks deep held in deepslate-tile walls, seven over the sump
a pillared causeway across the middle, arched underneath so you can swim beneath it
walkways along three walls with broken railings, ledge barrels and burned-down candles
the sunken vault behind a rusted iron grate at the bottom of the sump (one bar gone): its chest
the Old Delvers' lantern-and-picks mark inlaid in gold over the vault
the sluice room: a great oxidized-copper wheel dipping into the channel, a chained sluice gate, three levers
the Waterwarden's Ledger on its lectern, beside the waterwarden's bones
the drowned wake by the water stairs
a corner of the vault fallen in, open to the caves; old conduits lead away in two or three directions

hermit.name: Hermit's Hollow
features: a mossy natural cave with two giant mushrooms, the Bishop (red) and Old Thatch (brown), shroomlight under their caps
the hermit's spruce-and-mushroom-stem hut: bed, brewing stand, cauldron, shelves, pantry and keepsake chest
a lectern, "Notes on the Deep": a Guild miner who stayed below, mushrooms, quiet and warnings of the deep
a still pond with lily pads and dripleaf in a mud basin (and Mudge the axolotl), glow berries overhead
a slow mushroom garden named for the lost shift of the Buried Seam, nether wart for the brews, a campfire yard
a winding, lantern-lit crawl that climbs toward the outside and ends in an old roof-fall
home of one resident: the hermit (a cleric), who keeps the brewing stand

grotto.name: The Glimmering
features: a vast natural cavern lined like a geode: amethyst, budding amethyst, calcite, smooth-basalt veins
crystal clusters and buds, dripstone stalactites and glow lichen glittering in the dark
the Old Delvers' crystal shrine: a ring of deepslate-tile pillars crowned with candles and amethyst
a dais with the Great Lantern (the Old Delvers' mark), the shrine chest and offering pots
a still pool glowing from below with sea lanterns and froglights, crystals growing under the water
old carvings (signs) in the Old Delvers' voice, worn processional paths with tile steps
three tunnel mouths (jigsaw passages ending in old collapses); no guardians: the reward is finding it

ossuary.name: The Ossuary
features: a cross-shaped, vaulted central crypt of deepslate tiles, bricks and polished blackstone, its stepped dome hung with a soul-lantern chandelier over the Delvers' mark inlaid in the floor
walls of loculi: tiers of niches with laid-out bones, skulls, cobwebs and burned-down candles over a course of bone blocks, in the crypt and along every gallery
the crypt keeper rises in the crossing (crypt_keeper haunt)
the altar, and behind it the reliquary (ossuary/reliquary) under the Delvers' mark
a lectern, "Names of the Honoured Dead"
polished-deepslate sarcophagi with their chests sealed under the lid (ossuary/sarcophagus): break the lid
two side crypts, each with a skeleton spawner among the bones
galleries, bone-pillar junctions, stairs and tombs branch out and end in collapses

forge.name: The Sunken Forge
features: a great forge-hall of polished blackstone bricks and deepslate tiles over a lava lake, pillars capped in gold under a ribbed vault, iron chains hanging from the beams
the great hearth: lava behind an iron grate, two stone-and-leather bellows blowing into it through copper nozzles, the Delvers' mark on its chimney breast
banks of blast furnaces and smokers along both walls, behind lava channels bridged by stone
the colossal anvil (iron blocks on a blackstone foot) on its dais, a great hammer hanging over it on chains, working anvils and quench troughs round it
a lectern, "The Smith's Rule"
forge stores in the corners and side rooms (forge/supplies)
the masterwork vault on an island across the lava, reached over a narrow, broken bridge (forge/vault)
crucibles of lava hanging over the lake
cinders rise in the hall (cinder haunt)
passages, forks, stairs and storerooms lead out and end in rubble
